about: Shared expectations for grouped and long numbers: a comma-grouped number (1,250,000) is a quantity and is spelled out whatever its length (up to 15 digits); a bare run of 7+ digits (phone number, account, binary) stays digit by digit; groups over 15 digits fall back to digits. Backseat Driver: backseat::pronunciation::ForSpeech (libs/backseat/backseat_tests/spoken_numbers.json). EpubToM4B can port the same rule; keep both copies in sync.
